comparison.objective: Index a Geneva drive twice and demonstrate its dwell; candidate adjusts a shock absorber and verifies stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Drive rotation using native roller-slot contact versus fastener loosening, fine collar rotation, relocking, and iterative guarded impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Two mechanically coupled index cycles with stationary dwell before release versus two stops without travel, force, rebound, hard-stop, or drift violations.
comparison.reason: This is the closest mechanical-dynamics record, but it tests intermittent motion transmission and dwell rather than tunable energy absorption and retained adjustment.
